about.en: INTER is the official fan token of the Italian football club FC Internazionale Milano (Inter Milan), issued by Socios.com on Chiliz Chain at 0x1b3385a26214057bb7e27c173ee2d14201752e73 with 18 decimals. Holders use it on the Socios.com app to vote in club polls and to access rewards and fan experiences; it gives no ownership of the club. CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap also list bridged copies on Base and Solana.
